final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Only currencyservice is the outlier: pod currencyservice-665c44c9f4-5p79r is 0/1 Running with Restarts=0, deployment currencyservice 0/1 AVAILABLE=0, Service currencyservice has EMPTY ENDPOINTS while all other 10 services have endpoints, and CheckServiceConnectivity(currencyservice:7000) returned 'Connection Failed'; GetAlerts shows no metric anomalies. Mechanism event read verbatim from the pod: 'Warning Unhealthy 1s (x11 over 81s) kubelet Readiness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.1.7:7000/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response "\x00\x00\x00\x04..."' — the leading bytes are the HTTP/2 (gRPC) frame preamble, i.e. an HTTP probe hitting a gRPC port. Container logs self-confirm the port is gRPC: 'Starting gRPC server on port 7000...' / 'CurrencyService gRPC server started on port 7000'. Configuration face (GetAppYAML/currencyservice) shows the protocol mismatch on the same container: readinessProbe uses httpGet path=/ port=7000 while livenessProbe correctly uses grpc port=7000 — hence no liveness kill and Restart Count 0, and no OOMKilled/137 termination state anywhere. Expected a gRPC health answer; observed a malformed HTTP/1.x response, so the pod never becomes Ready, its endpoint is withdrawn, and callers (frontend CURRENCY_SERVICE_ADDR=currencyservice:7000) cannot reach the service.
